segments.mil7.6.8:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena, ‘jalūkāya ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’nti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba”nti?
segments.mil7.6.8:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, jalūkā yattha allīyati, tattheva daḷhaṃ allīyitvā ruhiraṃ pivati,
segments.mil7.6.8:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena yasmiṃ ārammaṇe cittaṃ allīyati, taṃ ārammaṇaṃ vaṇṇato ca saṇṭhānato ca disato ca okāsato ca paricchedato ca liṅgato ca nimittato ca daḷhaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā tenevārammaṇena vimuttirasamasecanakaṃ pātabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.6.8:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, jalūkāya ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
